fact: Early handheld mobile phones focused on voice calls and were bulky.
change: Smartphones combine calling with cameras, navigation, internet access, and apps.
takeaway: One pocket device replaced many separate gadgets.

fact: Film cameras recorded images on light-sensitive film that needed processing.
change: Digital cameras store electronic images that can be reviewed instantly.
takeaway: Seeing a photo no longer requires developing film.

fact: Portable cassette players played recorded music from physical tapes.
change: Streaming services deliver large music libraries through connected devices.
takeaway: Music moved from physical tapes to on-demand digital access.

fact: Many personal computers relied on bulky monitors and desktop towers.
change: Modern laptops combine a screen, keyboard, battery, and computer in one portable device.
takeaway: Computing moved from fixed desks to mobile workspaces.

fact: Travelers often planned routes using printed maps and road signs.
change: Satellite navigation can show a changing position and suggest routes.
takeaway: Directions became interactive instead of printed.

fact: CRT televisions used large picture tubes and deep cabinets.
change: Modern flat-panel displays are much thinner and often include internet features.

fact: Floppy disks carried relatively small amounts of data between computers.
change: Cloud storage can sync files across multiple internet-connected devices.
takeaway: Files moved beyond one physical disk.

fact: Many early home consoles loaded games from physical cartridges.
change: Modern gaming devices support digital distribution and online multiplayer.
takeaway: Games evolved from local cartridges to connected experiences.

fact: Mechanical and quartz wristwatches mainly displayed time.
change: Smartwatches can display notifications and track activity using sensors.
takeaway: A wristwatch can now do much more than tell time.

fact: Typewriters printed letters directly onto paper with mechanical keys.
change: Word processors let people edit and save text before printing or sharing.
takeaway: Editing text became easier and less wasteful.

fact: Incandescent lamps make light by heating a wire filament.
change: LED bulbs use semiconductor devices and typically need less electricity.
takeaway: Lighting became much more energy efficient.

fact: A posted letter could take days or longer to reach its recipient.
change: Instant messaging sends text and media over digital networks in seconds.
